notes.title: DuneBorn Devlog: Preparing for the Playtest
notes.notes:
[p]We are going through an intensive week of bug fixing and feature implementations, working hard to make sure the playtest experience is as smooth and enjoyable as possible.[/p][p]Today, I ran some internal tests on a dedicated server with a stable build, and I’m already seeing much better performance compared to the early tests a few months ago. We’re getting closer and closer to opening access to the playtest! ⚙️🎮[/p][p]There are still a few more days of bug fixing 🐛 and feature polishing ahead, but I’m expecting this phase to last no more than about a week.[/p][p]I want to sincerely thank all the players who signed up for the playtest and have been supporting the project on Discord. Some have even volunteered to help however they can — and that’s just incredible. I’m deeply grateful for all the energy and dedication from the community! 💛[/p][p]The waitlist for the playtest keeps growing, and I’m aware we might not have enough servers for everyone at first. But don’t worry: there’s a [b]plan B[/b] ready to make sure no one misses out on the adventure waiting in the dunes. 🏜️[/p][p]See you after the dust settles!
[b]Cheers![/b][/p][p]👉 [url="https://discord.com/invite/rDgUHZun2g"]Join our Discord community[/url]

[/p][previewyoutube="pkvw49MjsCI;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Duneborn Public Playtest is Coming!
notes.notes:
[p]🚨 DUNEBORN PLAYTEST IS VERY CLOSE! 🚨[/p][p]We’re getting closer to launching the public playtest of [b]Duneborn[/b] — our brutal multiplayer survival experience in a post-apocalyptic desert world![/p][p]🛠️ This week we’re starting internal tests, where we’ll polish the main mechanics that will be present in the playtest. Some important changes have been made to ensure the testing has maximum impact:[/p][p]⚠️ [b]Important changes in the Playtest:[/b][/p][p]🌐 Only dedicated servers will be available — it will not be possible to host local games or play offline.
Our focus is to identify and resolve issues in large-scale multiplayer sessions.[/p][p]🏕️ It will be possible to defend large camps during periodic attacks throughout the game session.
These events will help us test the combat systems and global event mechanics.[/p][p]🚗 [b]Basic vehicle customization[/b] will also be available!
Around 5 vehicles will be customizable during the playtest, focusing on accessories and suspension adjustments.[/p][p]🎁 [b]Playtest Rewards:[/b][/p][p]During the playtest, we’ll be watching closely on our official [b]Discord[/b] server for players who actively report bugs and give suggestions.
Those who stand out may receive a [b]permanent game key[/b] and continue participating in exclusive testing even after the playtest ends —
with early access to new features throughout development.[/p][p]💬 Our team will be online on Discord during the test period, interacting with the community and tracking all feedback.[/p][p]Get your vehicles ready, gear up your weapons, and prepare to face the dust —
we’ll meet soon in the sands of [b]Duneborn[/b]![/p][p]👉 Join our official Discord to participate: [url="https://discord.gg/rDgUHZun2g" style="button" buttoncolor="#56008f"]Discord[/url][/p]
